ᗧ PacMan
●

PAC-MAN Arcade Edition

An authentic arcade recreation with polyphonic synthesized audio, original ghost AI behaviors (Blinky, Pinky, Inky, Clyde), high scores, and smooth hardware rendering.

Lead Developer:
Md. Abu Rise Zunaed

Mobile Controls:
• Right Side: Large tactile 4-way arcade D-pad.
• Left Side: Start, Pause, and Mute sound toggle.
• Swipe Gestures: Swipe anywhere across the screen.
